scope: High-impact active ReShade v2.3 material response / EnvSpec / SpecRGB / owner gates, plus source-only opt-in gates. NOT a census of every conditional across 929 repo blobs. Status is SOURCE/ABI unless runtime/pixel explicitly observed.

status_definitions.REMOVED_UNPROVEN: Removed when no concrete protective benefit shown and scope provably wider than required.
status_definitions.ABI_REQUIRED: Required to avoid calling different shader ABI/transport.
status_definitions.CONCRETE_SOURCE_COUNTEREXAMPLE: Exact source bytes give a real invalid cross-identity case.
status_definitions.SOURCE_NECESSITY_PIXEL_OPEN: Producer/consumer necessity grounded but no PTDE pixel parity yet.
status_definitions.OPEN_COVERAGE_RESTRICTOR: Finite corpus may deny valid source joins, needs isolated source recovery.

entries.claim: The 38-row partial FLVER/slot census was an added shared EnvSpec veto. No concrete misrender prevented by it; temporal owner-reported nonmetal regression.
Added requirement that bound stock t1 SpecRGB equal a finite 38-row FLVER name, even when t1 logical identity/sidecar were independently established. No concrete avoided failure shown.

V296 injected at build suppressed diffuse Material Response and independent diffuse/normal resource requests by Oct10 t1 membership without actual known bad receiver/pixel comparison. Multiple V353-V356 stock fallback events but no proven pixel benefit. Removed from generated v2.3.0, frozen V359 untouched.
Dedicated PTDE HemEnv/EnvSpec consumer was established for RX33-35. Other RX represent different shader families and distinct CB/SRV ABI. Never substitute across receiver families.
entries.evidence: route345 indexed_issued RX33/RX34 in owner log

entries.claim: Original DSR MTD BND3 contains TWO different raw SHA digests for P_DullLeather[DSB].mtd. Name-only authorization would conflate different inputs. Keep full raw digest equality.

dsr_flver_owner_mtd_hash is a finite source manifest, not proof that every other live FLVER/slot is invalid. It presently blocks first-pass enrichment outside its source census. Live parser exact MTD fallback exists but does not independently prove all source owner tuples; do not blindly admit cross-model material.
entries.evidence: source original DSR FLVER and live parser; unknown source census completeness

entries.claim: PTDE EnvSpec MTD state PRESENT vs explicit NONE/NOSPC, encoded slot and homologous SPX define which semantic signal a shader consumes. Declaring absent PTDE EnvSpec as present would produce wrong operator.
entries.evidence: 325 original PTDE MTD records with slot/state, own source schema

entries.claim: EnvSpec transport has four representable slots; slot >=4 would index unsupported register layout.
Dedicated working P_Metal route345 source/env shader already handles its own PTDE operator. A second nonmetal island on the same draw would double-apply a semantic owner.
entries.evidence: owner confirms P_Metal visually active and route345 native draw issued
